axes.model_access: Mobvoi’s in-house TTS line: the official tutorial page cites a fifth-generation TTS engine and 48 kHz output. Voice cloning comes in Efficient (20 recorded sentences, hours), Quality (100+ audio clips and transcripts, 2–3 working days) and Custom (500 professional sentences, 5–7 working days) tiers, with API access (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: The moyin.com web app is the main entry, alongside mobile apps, a mini program and the “Sequence Monkey” open-platform API; synthesis runs in the vendor cloud. Sentence-by-sentence audition, selection audition and full-text synthesis all happen in the browser (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Albums and articles live account-side in the cloud, and albums do not share data; finished audio downloads as mp3 after “save and generate audio file”. Mobile and mini-program clients share the account system (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Interactive editing plus synthesis: long articles take longer to render, and failures are retried by contacting support or resubmitting. The workflow centres on sentence-level editing, audition and re-synthesis, without a pauseable cloud job queue (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Text dubbing (multi-voice, emotion, speed), sentence audition, polyphone/prosody/number correction, pause and silence insertion (600 ms default between paragraphs), multi-role dubbing (voice per segment), voice conversion, “voice crafting”, cloud video editing and one-click video parsing (2026-11-21).
axes.context: “Albums” provide project context: each album has admin, chief editor and editor roles, and data and operations belong only to the current album, which can be switched in real time. This is team-workspace isolation rather than conversational memory, with voice assets providing cross-article consistency (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts plus album-admin billing: synthesis charges the current album admin’s balance, and insufficient funds block synthesis. Voice cloning requires a membership for editor use, with cloning and commercial rights under the official agreement; the agreement prohibits illegal cloning of TTS data and infringement of voice rights (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: Chinese dubbing pipelines (audiobooks, short video, courseware), multi-user album collaboration, cloning one’s own voice and domestic direct access. Not fit: cloning others (a consent red line), open weights/offline deployment, or English-first work (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official site, help centre, voice-cloning page and user agreement. Clone-consent strictness, multi-user efficiency and emotion granularity need account-level measurement.
unknowns:
- Generative-AI service filing number: check beian.cac.gov.cn (algorithm and service filings use separate numbering).
- Training-use controls: check the official agreement and privacy page.
- Tier boundaries for commercial rights: check the membership agreement text.
- Cross-session memory: the product isolates albums and does not share data across them; conversational memory is not part of the product surface.
related: Both domestic TTS/cloning lines: MiniMax is API-strong, Moyin Workshop is dubbing-workflow-strong.
Also cloning-oriented: fish audio has a community voice ecosystem, Moyin Workshop an official voice library + workflows.
International contrast: ElevenLabs has a wider multilingual surface, Moyin Workshop finer Chinese dubbing workflows.
Downstream of dubbing: finished voiceovers are often stitched with AI video assets into final cuts — the two lines meet in short-video workflows (cross-linked after filing).
